items.title: 씨게이트, 브로드컴 대용량 HDD 호환성 확보

items.title: '해외 의존도 70% 절감' 큐알티, 평가장비 개발 공로 인정

items.title: SK머티리얼즈, 日 후루카와전공과 반도체 소재 MOU 체결
items.snippet: SK에코플랜트 머티리얼즈(이하 SK머티리얼즈)가 일본 후루카와 전기공업주식회사(이하 후루카와전공)와 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터용 반도체 소재 업무협력 양해각서(MOU)를 체결했다고 28일 밝혔다. 후루카와공업은 금속·폴리머·포토닉스·고주파 등 4대 핵심 기술을 중심으로 광솔루션, 정보컴포넌트, 에너지 인프라, 자동차 전장 시스템, 메탈 솔루션 등에서 다양한 제품군을 보유한 업체다. 반도체와 AI 데이터센터 관련 고기능 소재를 중심으로 양사의 기술력을 결합한다. 후루카와전공이 반도체와 데이터센터용 신제품을 개발한다. 이후 SK머티리얼

items.title: SKC, 15분기 연속 적자...3분기 적자폭은 줄었다
items.snippet: SKC가 올해 3분기 영업손실폭을 전년 동기 대비 줄였지만 15분기 연속 적자를 면치 못했다. 배터리 소재 사업이 발목을 잡았다. 반면 반도체 소재 사업은 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 호황에 성장세를 이어갔다.SKC는 올해 3분기 연결매출 6389억원, 영업손실 496억원을 기록했다고 28일 밝혔다. 매출은 전년 동기 대비 약 26% 증가했다. 영업손실은 전년 동기(549억원) 대비 53억원 감소했다.2023년 1분기부터 15분기 연속 영업적자다. 전기차 시장 성장 둔화로 배터리 시장 침체가 장기화한 탓이다.특히 자회사 SK넥실리스가

items.title: 퀄컴, 블루칩 프로젝트에 스냅드래곤 X 플랫폼 공급

items.title: LG화학, 엔솔 지분 2.5조 처분…"4천억원으로 주주환원"

items.snippet: 삼성물산[028260]이 계열사인 삼성바이오로직스[207940]의 유상증자에 참여해 약 9천190억원을 출자한다.삼성물산은 28일 이사회를 열고 삼성바이오로직스 보통주 78만2천818주를 취득하기로 결의했다고 공시했다.출자 금액은 9천190억2천800만원 규모다.이번 출자 후 삼성물산의 삼성바이오로직스 총출자액은 3조776억700만원으로 늘어난다.출자 일자는 구주주 청약 종료일인 오는 11월 10일이다.삼성물산은 출자 목적에 대해 "중장기 성장동력인 바이오 사업 투자"라고 밝혔다.yyhan@yna.co.kr<저작권자 (c) 연합인

items.title: 與 “조희대 국조 실시… 내달 5일 본회의 상정”
items.snippet: 더불어민주당이 대법관 후보자 재제청 거부 등을 사유로 조희대 대법원장에 대한 국정조사를 실시하기로 했다. 사법부 수장에 대한 입법부의 국정조사는 처음이다. 국민의힘은 “노골적인 사법부 탄압이고 명백한 삼권분립 위반”이라고 반발했다. 민주당 한병도 원내대표는 27일 의원총회에서 “대법관 재제청 거부와 공백 장기화부터 현금 격려금과 업무추진비 집행까지 조 대법원장 본인을 둘러싼 의혹도 겹겹이 쌓이고 있다”며 “제기된 의혹을 철저히 규명하고 국민적 의구심을 해소하는 것은 국회가 마땅히 해야 할 책무”라고 밝혔다. 전은수 원내대변인은 비공개 의총을 마친 뒤 기자들과 만나 “조 대법원장에 대한 국정조사를 해야 한다는 데 의견이 모아졌고, 국정조사를 실시하기로 했다”고 했다. 민주당은 다음 달 5일 국회 본회의에 국정조사 요구서를 보고하고, 다음 12일...

items.title: 애기봉 1.4㎞ 앞, 南 겨눈 北 자주포
items.snippet: 북한 병사들이 27일 경기 김포시 애기봉에서 약 1.4km 떨어진 황해북도 개풍군 일원에서 깃발을 흔들며 덕천포(M-1975 122mm 자주포) 정비 및 발사 준비 훈련을 하고 있다. 북한이 최근 전술적 타격 수단의 증강 배치를 거론한 가운데 의도적으로 자주포를 노출시키며 무력 과시를 하고 있다는 분석이 나온다.

items.title: 與도 시행 두달 남은 ‘코인과세’ 유예 의견 모아
items.snippet: 정부가 내년 1월로 예정된 가상자산 과세를 다시 유예하는 쪽에 무게를 두고 있는 가운데 여당도 27일 의원총회에서 과세를 미뤄야 한다는 쪽으로 가닥을 잡은 것으로 전해졌다. 여당은 정부와 28일 당정협의를 열고 이 같은 의견을 전달할 예정이다. 더불어민주당 김한규 원내정책수석부대표는 이날 의원총회를 마친 뒤 기자들과 만나 “가상자산 과세 유예 자체에 반대하는 분은 없고 오히려 유예가 필요하다는 개인 의견들이 나왔다”며 “분위기는 유예 쪽으로 모아지고 있는 게 아닌가 싶다”고 밝혔다. 예정대로 과세를 시행해야 한다는 의견보다는 유예론에 힘이 실렸다는 의미다. 이날 의원총회 토론에서는 디지털자산기본법을 먼저 제정한 뒤 가상자산 과세를 함께 시행해야 한다는 의견도 제시된 것으로 알려졌다. 가상자산의 법적 지위를 정하는 디지털자산기본법을 통해 발행·...

items.title: 曺 겨눈 與, 대법관 재제청 거부 경위-계엄당시 회의 조사 거론
items.snippet: 더불어민주당이 27일 의원총회에서 조희대 대법원장을 겨냥한 국정조사를 추진하기로 하면서 조 대법원장에 대한 공세를 본격화했다. 지난해 이재명 대통령의 공직선거법 사건에 대한 대법원의 파기환송 판결 이후 이어져 왔던 여권과 조 대법원장 간의 긴장관계가 대법관 후보자 재제청 거부 사태로 초유의 대법원장에 대한 국정조사로 이어진 것. 조 대법원장은 이날 퇴근길에 국정조사 추진에 대해 묻는 취재진의 질문에 답하지 않았다.● 與 “다음 달 5일 국조 계획서 본회의 보고” 민주당 전은수 원내대변인은 이날 의원총회를 마친 뒤 “조 대법원장 향후 조치와 관련해 국정조사를 해야 한다는 데 의견이 모아졌고, 실시하기로 했다”며 “국조를 해서 밝힐 것들을 밝혀야 한다는 것”이라고 했다. 당초 당내 강경파와 조국혁신당 등을 중심으로 즉시 탄핵에 나서야 한다는 의견...

items.title: 강경파는 “국조 말고 바로 탄핵해야”
items.snippet: 더불어민주당이 의원총회에서 조희대 대법원장에 대한 탄핵 추진에 앞서 국정조사를 실시하기로 결정했지만 친청(친정청래)계 등 강경파와 조국혁신당에서는 “국정조사가 아니라 바로 탄핵을 해야 한다”는 주장이 나온다. 국정조사는 이르면 연말에 끝날 것으로 예상되는 만큼 그 이후 탄핵소추안을 의결하면 조 대법원장 퇴임까지 헌법재판소 결정이 나오지 않을 수 있다는 주장이다. 27일 민주당은 다음 달 5일 열리는 본회의에서 조 대법원장 관련 국정조사요구서를 보고할 예정이라고 밝혔다. 이후 1, 2주 동안 여야 협의 등을 거쳐 국정조사계획서를 채택하겠다는 방침이다. 국정조사는 40∼50일간 진행될 것으로 예상된다. 가장 최근에 실시된 6월 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사의 기간은 45일이었고, 3월 윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 국정조사는 50일...

items.title: 與 ‘조희대 휴대전화 교체 내역’ 조회 논란
items.snippet: 국회 과학기술정보방송통신위원회 소속 의원들이 국정감사 기간 동안 조희대 대법원장의 휴대전화 기기 교체 내역을 확인한 사실이 드러났다. 자료를 요구한 더불어민주당 황정아 의원은 27일 “국회의 적법한 의결 자료에 대해 ‘사찰’이라는 식으로 몰고 가는 것에 대해 깊은 유감을 표한다”고 밝혔다. 국회에 따르면 과방위는 22일 황 의원실 요구로 SK텔레콤, KT, LG유플러스 등 이동통신 3사로부터 제출받은 조 대법원장의 휴대전화 기기 변경 내역 유무와 시점, 기종 등과 관련된 자료를 열람했다. 제출된 자료에는 특정 기간 동안 조 대법원장의 ‘휴대전화 기기 변경 내역이 없다’는 답변과 함께 조 대법원장의 개인 휴대전화 번호가 포함됐다. 이에 정치권에서 사생활 침해와 사찰 논란이 제기되자 황 의원은 적법한 절차에 따라 의결해 제출받은 자료라는 취지로...

items.title: 李, 중수청장 배석 논란에 “비정상의 정상화… 한달에 한번쯤 오라”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 27일 “비정상의 정상화”라며 중대범죄수사청장(중수청장) 등 수사기관장의 국무회의 참석 원칙을 고수했다. 다만 “다른 일이 있는데 억지로 올 필요는 없다”며 “그래도 한 달에 한 번쯤은 오라”고 했다. 수사기관장의 국무회의 참석이 독립성과 정치적 중립성을 훼손한다는 비판을 재차 반박하면서도 ‘조건부 참석’이라는 절충안을 택한 것으로 풀이된다.● 李 “중수청장, 한 달에 한 번쯤 오라” 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “비정상에 오랫동안 노출되다 보면 그 비정상이 정상인 것처럼 오인되고, 오히려 정상이 비정상으로 이해되는 경우도 많다”며 “그런 잘못된 관행이나 일종의 열외 등을 시정하는 게 개혁이고 발전”이라고 말했다. 과거 검찰총장 등 수사기관장이 정치적 중립과 수사 독립을 고려해 국무회의에 참석하지 않았던 관...

items.title: [단독]李정부 임명 공공기관 임원 20% ‘경기-성남, 민주당, 중앙대’ 출신
items.snippet: 이재명 정부 출범 후 임명된 공공기관 임원 5명 중 1명은 ‘경기·성남 라인’ 등 이 대통령과 관계가 있는 인물로 채워졌다는 주장이 나왔다. 일부 인사들은 국정감사 과정에서 불공정 채용 의혹까지 불거지면서 야권은 “낙하산 인사”라고 비판하고 나섰다.●‘경성 라인’ 23명…野 국감서 “낙하산” 비판27일 국회 운영위원회 소속 국민의힘 김승수 의원실이 공공기관 경영정보 공개시스템 ‘알리오’에 게재된 공기업·준정부기관·기타공공기관 342곳의 임원 현황 공시를 분석한 결과 이재명 정부 출범 이후 새로 선임된 상임 임원은 364명이었다. 김 의원실은 이 중 20%인 74명이 인맥·학맥 등으로 이 대통령 및 현 정권과 연결고리가 있는 것으로 봤다. 의원실은 이 중 23명은 이 대통령이 성남시장, 경기도지사일 때 연이 있는 경기·성남 라인으로 분류했다....

items.title: 견제 주고받는 ‘장-이-한’, 吳에 구애 동상이몽
items.snippet: 오세훈 서울시장이 여론조사비 대납 의혹 항소심에서 무죄를 선고받은 가운데 국민의힘 장동혁 대표, 개혁신당 이준석 의원, 무소속 한동훈 의원이 오 시장과 동상이몽의 ‘사각관계’를 형성했다는 분석이 나온다. 장 대표와 이 의원, 한 의원이 서로 각을 세우면서도 오 시장을 향해선 구애에 나서고 있는 것. 6·3 지방선거 당시 오 시장과 갈등을 거듭했던 장 대표는 26일 국립서울현충원에서 열린 박정희 전 대통령 추모식에서 오 시장과 만나 웃으며 악수했다. 이날 오 시장이 “특검이 상고를 포기해야 한다는 목소리를 내주셔서 고맙다”고 하자, 장 대표는 “대표로서 당연히 할 일”이라고 답했다.이 의원은 오 시장이 항소심 선고 당시 서울고법을 찾은 국민의힘 의원 8명을 26일 초청한 만찬에 참석했다. 이 의원은 만찬에서 “오뚝이처럼, 세파를 이겨내니, 훈풍...

items.title: [단독]北, 남포 등서 잠수정으로 대남 해상 침투훈련
items.snippet: 북한이 남포 등 일부 지역에서 잠수함정과 공작모선 등 침투 훈련을 이어온 정황을 정보당국이 포착한 것으로 알려졌다. 북한이 비무장지대(DMZ) 지뢰 폭발 사건 이후 접경지역 일대 국지 도발 위협 수위를 높이는 가운데 대남 공작 활동을 강화하려는 움직임을 보이고 있는 것으로 풀이된다. 27일 정부 고위 소식통은 “정보당국이 북한이 하계훈련을 계기로 이런 훈련을 지속해 온 동향을 주시하고 있는 것으로 안다”고 전했다. 공작모선은 공작원이나 소형 잠수정, 침투 장비 등을 싣고 이동하면서 목표 해역에서 이들을 투입하거나 회수하는 모선(母船) 역할을 하는 선박이다.정보당국은 이 같은 북한의 동향이 최근 북한 정찰총국의 정찰정보총국 확대 개편 움직임과 맞물려 진행되고 있는 것으로 분석하고 있다. 앞서 7월 북한 노동당 중앙군사위원회 확대회의에서 김정은...

items.title: “미군 믿을수 있냐”는 강신철에… 野 “동맹 흔드는 망언, 경질을”
items.snippet: 강신철 국방부 장관(사진)의 “북한과 전쟁이 나면 미군을 믿을 수 있느냐”는 26일 발언의 파장이 확산되고 있다. 강 장관은 “미국이 이란 전쟁에서 어려움을 겪고 있다는 (야당) 의원의 얘기에 대해 반문한 것”이라고 말했지만 국민의힘 등 야권은 “동맹을 흔드는 망언”이라며 강 장관의 경질을 요구했다. 더불어민주당 일각에서 미국이 전시작전통제권 전환에 반대하면 독자 환수를 선언해야 한다고 요구하는 가운데 정동영 통일부 장관은 “조건이 아닌 시기를 정해 전작권을 환수해야 한다”고 주장했다.● “동맹 흔드는 망언, 李 대통령이 경질해야”강 장관은 27일 전날 ‘미군을 믿을 수 있느냐’는 발언에 대해 “어느 의원(국민의힘 성일종 의원)께서 미국이 이란 전쟁에서 많이 어려움을 겪고 있다고 그러시니까 반문을 한 것”이라고 말했다. 강 장관은 26일 국회...

items.title: 조현 “루비오 美국무, 북미대화 기대 관련… 한국이 너무 앞서가지 않길 바란다고 해”

items.title: ‘세계 5위 군사력?’… 6·25 직전 오판과 닮았다
items.snippet: 여의도 국회의원 회관은 엘리베이터가 여러 군데 있어 길 한번 잘못 들면 헤매기 십상인데, 박충권 의원실은 단번에 찾았습니다. 915호. 초선 의원실이 꽤 높은 층에 있다고 하자 박 의원, “제가 국회에선 고위층입니다” 해서 웃음이 터졌지요. 9층 복도를 걷다 보니 정동영, 이진숙 의원실도 보이더군요. 참고로 ‘최고위층’은 10층입니다. “북한 군사력 이란보다 10배 강해… 핵 빼고 싸워도 진다”는 파격적 제목으로 나간 인터뷰 로 박충권 의원실이 며칠 소란했던 모양입니다. 현 정부의 안보 참사에 경종을 울렸다는 격려가 많았지만, 요즘 각광받는 ‘K방산’을 폄훼했다는 질타도 받았다네요. 댓글 중에는 ‘북한 군사력을 그토록 찬양할 거면 북으로 가라!’는 악플도 있더군요. 문해력 제로이거나, 이른바 ‘개딸’로 통칭되는 이들의 조롱 혹은 협박이겠지요.

items.title: 성적 맞춰 간 의대… 사명감 없는 의사의 불행한 미래
items.snippet: 수능 시험과 입시철이 다가온다. 올해도 대학마다 다소 차이는 있겠지만 수능 성적 전체 0.3% 앞뒤 학생들이 소위 인기 학과인 의대에 몰릴 것이다. 그런데 의사를 직업으로 선택할 때는 다른 직업도 마찬가지지만 본인의 가치관과 적성, 사명의식이라는 면에서 더 심각한 고민을 해야 한다고 생각한다. 왜냐하면 의사라는 직업은 철저한 사명의식이 필요한 직업이기 때문이다. 그렇지 않고 단지 안정적인 직업과 고수입의 처우가 보장되기 때문에, 또는 좋게 나온 성적이 아까워서 선택한다면 이 직업은 대단히 불행한 선택이 될 수 있기 때문이다.

items.title: SLICE-CiM: Selective Layer-wise Inference Control Engine with Confidence-Based Early Exit for SRAM based Digital Compute-in-Memory
items.abstract: Digital SRAM compute-in-memory (CIM) macros enable energy-efficient CNN inference by eliminating off-chip weight transfers; however, peripheral control logic introduces three inefficiencies: bit- slice over-activation at reduced precision (L1), unnecessary accumula- tion depth (L2), and idle precision-transition stalls (L3). To address these, we present four synthesizable peripheral blocks: a Flush-Merge Enable (FME) controller, a Confidence-Based Early-Exit (EE) module, a Precision Register with Decoder (PR/PD), and a Bit-Serial Cycle Controller (CC), co-designed to minimize switching activity, wordline overhead, and leakage. Implemented in TSMC 65-nm CMOS at 335 MHz, the peripheral framework occupies 1769.760 μm2 post-synthesis and 1982.131 μm2 post-PnR. items.title: A Fast and Memory-Efficient Algorithm for Searching Faint Moving Objects using Synthetic Tracking
items.abstract: Detecting unknown faint moving objects using optical imaging is challenging. Long exposure times are infeasible for such targets, as the resulting image streaking causes a loss of signal-to-noise ratio due to energy dispersal across multiple pixels. To address this, synthetic tracking, a track-before-detect method, replaces long exposures with many short exposures, integrating them in post-processing to recover the moving signal. Enabled by modern CMOS detectors with fast readout and low read noise, this technique synthesizes telescope tracking by searching over a grid of velocities. However, the conventional brute-force implementation imposes a significant computational burden: integrating N_f frames of size (N_x,N_y) requires O(N_x N_y N_f^3) operations. items.title: Back-End-Of-Line Integration of 2-Terminal Ferroelectric Hafnia Synaptic Weights on Commercial CMOS Process
items.abstract: Functionalising the back-end-of-line (BEOL) of CMOS with emerging materials is a key route to neural network accelerators and neuromorphic systems. In this work, we demonstrate for the first time the integration of 2-terminal ferroelectric synaptic weights in the BEOL of as-delivered commercial 180 nm CMOS dies. A novel material stack is proposed, in which a WOx/[HfO2-ZrO2] bilayer is sandwiched between TiN and Mo electrodes. For devices annealed at 450 °C, programming below 1.8 V is achieved with a cycle-to-cycle variation below 3 %. Synaptic weights annealed at 500 °C exhibit more gradual weight updates, while the tested underlying NMOS transistors remain functional after the complete integration process. The trade-off between thermal budget and on-device training performance is illustrated using hardware-aware neural network simulations.

items.snippet: 27일 오후 서울 강남구 구룡마을에서 큰불이 나 화염과 검은 연기가 치솟고 있다. 불길이 판잣집을 타고 번지면서 주민 39명이 긴급 대피했다. 강남 일대에는 매캐한 연기가 퍼졌다. 소방 당국은 “오후 11시 현재 인명 피해는 없다”며 “강풍이 불고 용수가 부족해 진압에 시간이 걸리고 있다”고 밝혔다. 구룡마을은 서울의 마지막 판자촌으로 불린다. 2023년 1월과 올 1월에도 큰불이 났다. 이재명 대통령은 “가용한 자원을 총동원해 인명 구조와 안전 확보에 만전을 기하라”고 지시했다. 오세훈 서울시장은 국회의원 만찬 등 일정을 취소하고 현장을 찾아 점검했다.

items.title: 2030 여성들, 갑자기 쿵… 취한게 아닙니다
items.snippet: 서울 중구의 한 회사에 다니는 A(26)씨는 지난달 퇴근길에 갑자기 정신을 잃고 쓰러졌다. 눈을 떠보니 시간은 5분가량 지났고 주변에는 사람들이 모여 있었다. 한 경찰관은 A씨를 깨우며 “길거리에서 이러면 안 된다. 택시 타고 집에 가라”고 했다. A씨는 “경찰관이 나를 술에 취해 길에 누워 있는 사람으로 생각하는 것 같았다”고 했다.

items.title: 작년 온실가스 농도, 전 세계 역대 최고치
items.snippet: 작년 한 해 온난화를 유발하는 주요 온실가스(이산화탄소·메탄·아산화질소)의 전(全) 지구 평균 농도가 관측 이래 또다시 최고치를 기록했다. 한국은 온실가스 농도가 세계 평균보다 더 높은 것으로 나타났다.

items.title: 일본·인니 친구들에게… “이게 한국 된장이야” 영상 소개
items.snippet: 27일 서울 강북구 번동초등학교에서 ‘음식 문화’를 주제로 열린 한국·일본·인도네시아 3국 실시간 화상 국제공동수업에서 한 여학생이 숟가락으로 뜬 된장을 화면 앞에 들어 보이며 설명하고 있다. 이날 수업에는 세 나라 학생·교사 110여 명이 참여해 각국 전통 음식과 식사 예절을 소개했다.

items.title: 우울증·불안장애 환자 194만명… 4년새 20% 늘었다
items.snippet: 서울 마포구에 사는 직장인 김모(29)씨는 지난달 집 근처 정신건강의학과를 찾았다. 회사 일에 집중하기 어렵고 툭 하면 눈물이 났다. 감정 기복이 심해지면서 연인과의 관계도 불안정해졌고, 극단적 생각까지 들었다고 한다. 병원에서 우울증 진단을 받은 김씨는 약물 치료를 받고 있다.

items.title: 李, 검찰개혁 ‘무극파’ 사과 요구에 “선동적 주장으로 발목잡는 분도 있어”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 검찰개혁 추진 방식과 속도를 둘러싸고 여권 및 진보 진영 내부에서 흘러나오는 비판 목소리에 “선동적 주장을 함으로써 실질적으로는 검찰개혁을 발목잡는 분들도 있다”고 지적했다. 이 대통령은 28일 X(옛 트위터)를 통해 “검찰개혁을 진심으로 국가와 국민을 위해 주장하는 분도 있고, 자신의 숨겨진 정치적 사적 목적을 위해 선명성만 내세우거나 과도한 선동적 주장을 함으로써 실질적으로는 검찰개혁을 발목 잡는 분들도 있다”고 밝혔다.이어 “일부 국민들의 조급하고 절박한 개혁 열망에 편승해 개혁 실패의 불안감을 자극하며 자기만 선명한 개혁 주체인 양 ‘전부 아니면 전무’ 식의 선동을 하고 진짜 개혁을 하려는 동지를 공격하며 실질적·실효적 개혁의 실패로 이끌어 가는 것이 무책임한 극단주의”라고 강하게 비판했다.이날 이 대통령 메시지는 한...

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [노벨 평화상] 전쟁·인권·환경 두루 다루지만… 논란도 많은 상이래요
items.snippet: 2026년 노벨 평화상은 남아프리카공화국 출신 인권법 전문가 나비 필라이(85)에게 돌아갔어요. 필라이는 인종차별에 맞선 변호사로 출발해 국제 재판소 재판관과 유엔의 인권 정책을 총괄하는 유엔 인권최고대표 등을 지냈어요. 노르웨이 노벨위원회는 필라이를 수상자로 발표하면서 “우리 시대 국제법의 대표적 수호자”라고 평가했습니다. 이어 “전쟁 범죄와 반인도적 범죄, 집단 학살이 처벌받도록 하는 데 중요한 역할을 했다”고 선정 이유를 밝혔어요. 필라이는 어떤 삶을 살았는지, 노벨 평화상은 어떤 상인지 함께 살펴볼까요?

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [동물 이야기] 아름다운 광택 가져 단추 재료로 인기… 새끼 땐 물고기 몸에 기생한대요
items.snippet: 기후에너지환경부는 사라질 위기에 처한 ‘멸종 위기 야생생물’을 매달 한 종류씩 자세히 알리고 있어요. 이달의 멸종 위기 야생생물은 두드럭조개랍니다. 조개 하면 대합·홍합·바지락·꼬막처럼 맛있는 바다 조개가 먼저 떠오르는데요. 민물조개인 두드럭조개는 강의 오염을 막아주는 수질 청정기 역할을 해 온 고마운 친구랍니다. 두드럭조개라는 재미있는 이름은 껍데기 표면이 마치 두드러기가 난 것처럼 오톨도톨한 작은 돌기들로 덮여 있다는 데서 유래했어요. 다 자라면 껍데기 길이가 9㎝에 달해 민물조개치고는 아주 큰 편이죠. 기다란 만큼 두께도 두툼한 데다 안쪽에는 아름다운 광택이 돌아서 단추 재료로 인기가 많아 일본에 수출까지 했을 정도랍니다.

items.title: ​[신문은 선생님] [예쁜 말 바른 말] [468] ‘내일모레’와 ‘글피’
items.snippet: ‘오늘’을 기준으로 다음 날을 ‘내일’, 그다음 날은 ‘모레’라고 합니다. 그렇다면 ‘모레’의 다음 날은 무엇일까요? 정답은 ‘글피’입니다. 오늘을 기준으로 하루, 이틀, 사흘, 나흘 뒤는 차례대로 ‘내일’, ‘모레’, ‘글피’, ‘그글피’라고 부릅니다. 예를 들어 오늘이 월요일이라면 내일은 화요일, 모레는 수요일, 글피는 목요일, 그글피는 금요일이지요.

items.title: [신문은 선생님] [알립니다] 중등 NIE 11·12월 수강생 모집
items.snippet: 조선일보 NIE 교육센터에서 ‘2026년 중등 NIE(신문 활용 교육) 11~12월’ 수강생을 모집합니다. NIE 수업은 다양한 분야의 신문 기사와 교과 연계 자료를 바탕으로, 학생들이 스스로 읽고 생각하며 표현하는 주도적 학습력을 키워줍니다. 문해력과 어휘력을 다지고 체계적인 글쓰기와 토론 활동으로 비판적 사고력을 기를 수 있습니다. 수업은 오프라인 수업(대치 본원)과 온라인 수업으로 진행됩니다.

items.snippet: “빈곤 지역 주민들에게 일방적으로 식량만 나눠 주는 것은 오히려 해(害)가 될 수 있습니다.” 국제 구호 단체 ‘기아대책 국제연대(FHIF)’를 이끄는 랜달 호그(68·미국) 회장. 그는 본지 인터뷰에서 “물질적 지원만으로는 주민들의 생각과 삶의 방식을 바꾸기 어렵다”며 “스스로 가난에서 벗어날 힘을 키우지 못하면 지원이 끊긴 뒤 다시 빈곤에 빠질 수 있기 때문”이라고 했다. 호그 회장 인터뷰는 지난 19일 서울 강서구 기아대책 사무실에서 진행됐다.

items.title: Prospector: learning a compact graph traversal policy for scientific reasoning
items.abstract: Scientific reasoning in specialized engineering fields depends on knowledge scattered across the literature, often proprietary and absent from frontier LLM training data. In such domains, frontier models tend to give generic answers. Knowledge graphs (KGs) can ground LLM reasoning. Because a graph is too large to provide in full, typical LLM+KG systems preselect a portion, deciding relevance before reasoning begins. Here we train a compact model, Prospector, to reason over a domain knowledge graph by traversing it step by step, seeking evidence in light of what it has already found. Prospector calls a small set of tools one at a time to progressively build its context, and answers with a chain of evidence that can be checked edge by edge against what its tools retrieved from the graph. items.title: First-Principles Investigation of Irida-Graphane: A Wide-Band-Gap Semiconductor Derived from Irida-Graphene
items.abstract: Opening a band gap in metallic two-dimensional carbon allotropes is an important step toward their use in electronic and optoelectronic devices, and full hydrogenation has proven to be an effective route to achieve it. Here, we propose irida-graphane, the fully hydrogenated derivative of the irida-graphene, a monolayer composed of three-, six-, and eight-membered rings, and investigate its structural, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties using density functional theory (DFT) at the PBE and HSE06 levels combined with phonon and \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. All carbon atoms adopt $sp^3$ hybridization, with the hydrogen atoms of the three- and six-membered rings bonded to opposite sides of a buckled carbon framework, and the lattice parameter contracts by 4.3% with respect to irida-graphene. items.title: ZnO/Ni interface-activated enhancement of spintronic terahertz emission from Ni/Pt bilayers
items.abstract: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters based on ferromagnet/heavy-metal bilayers provide an efficient route for generating broadband THz radiation through ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. However, Ni/Pt bilayers usually exhibit relatively weak THz emission, limiting their use as efficient spintronic emitters. Here, we report an interface-assisted enhancement of THz emission in ZnO/Ni/Pt heterostructures. By placing ZnO underneath Ni while preserving the direct Ni/Pt contact, the THz amplitude is increased by up to approximately 2.8 times compared with the Ni/Pt reference. The enhanced emission reverses polarity with the magnetic field and follows the expected angular dependence of ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. items.title: Machine Learning Hamiltonians with Polarizations for Heterogeneous Systems
items.abstract: Machine learning Hamiltonians use local atomic structures to determine local Hamiltonian matrix elements without carrying out self-consistent calculations. They have been used to study large systems and to carry out high-throughput screening for their electronic and optical properties. The prediction of the Hamiltonian is essentially the prediction of the electron electrostatic potential energy; however, for heterogeneous systems, this potential energy is often determined by faraway features, such as interface or surface dipoles, or even an applied voltage in a nanodevice. Thus, it cannot be determined by local atomic structures alone. In this sense, one needs to solve the electron electrostatic potential energy self-consistently using intrinsic atomic dipoles, the applied external potential energy, and polarizabilities. items.snippet: 삼성전자가 동남아시아·오세아니아 상업용 세탁 시장 공략에 나섰다. 18kg 대용량 세탁기와 14kg 건조기를 앞세워 빨래방과 호텔, 병원 수요를 겨냥한다. 생활가전 사업을 기업간거래(B2B) 시장으로 확대하는 행보다. 삼성전자는 이달 싱가포르에서 'B2B 세탁기(WF9100F)'와 'B2B 건조기(DV9100F)'를 출시했다. 인도네시아·말레이시아·필리핀·싱가포르·태국·베트남이 1차 출시국이다. 이후 동남아·오세아니아 전역으로 판매를 넓힌다.

items.title: Demonstration of high output power (3.75 W/mm) with 31.8% PAE in Ga-Polar AlGaN/GaN HEMTs on sapphire at 94 GHz
items.abstract: In this work, a recessed-gate Ga-polar AlGaN/GaN high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) on sapphire incorporating an AlGaN back-barrier for W-band operation is demonstrated. The device achieves a subthreshold slope of ~130 mV/dec, a peak transconductance of 0.75 S/mm, and an fmax exceeding 240 GHz. Continuous-wave load-pull measurements at 94 GHz show an output power of 3.75 W/mm with a power-added efficiency of 31.8%. This performance significantly exceeds the best previously reported Ga-polar devices on sapphire and approaches that of state-of-the-art Ga-polar devices on SiC, which provides a promising pathway toward high-performance W-band devices.

items.title: Coherent Optical Control of a Single Donor Electron Spin
items.abstract: Coherent spin-photon interfaces are essential for scalable quantum networks, but their realization requires optically bright transitions, long-lived spin coherence, and complete coherent control. Donor-bound electron spins in II-VI semiconductors offer an attractive platform for optically active spin qubits because they combine strong donor-bound exciton transitions in a direct-bandgap material with a potentially nuclear-spin-free environment. However, coherent control of an individual optically active donor spin has remained elusive. Here we demonstrate optical initialization, coherent control, and readout of a single donor-bound electron spin in ZnSe. Using spin-selective donor-bound exciton optical transitions, we initialize the electron spin and directly resolve its spin-relaxation dynamics. We achieve coherent spin control with off-resonant picosecond optical pulses, as demonstrated...

Repeated GO-PDDA assembly and spatially selective ablation enable atomic-scale thickness control and the construction of precise multilevel phase profiles, reducing phase-quantization errors and improving focusing efficiency. items.title: Generation of quantum light with tunable Wigner negativity with a semiconductor quantum dot
items.abstract: Wigner-negative states of light are key resources for quantum advantage in continuous-variable optical quantum computing. They can be produced probabilistically via frequency conversion and photon detection, or deterministically by exploiting the single-photon nonlinearity of a quantum emitter. Here, we generate such Wigner-negative states of light with a tunable negativity using a single semiconductor quantum dot in a cavity. Optical coherent control of the quantum-dot transition allows to generate a quantum superposition of zero and one photon. The generated quantum states are characterized point-by-point in the phase space through homodyne measurement. The emergence of Wigner-function negativity is observed as the excitation power is increased. items.abstract: Cybersecurity education has predominantly focused on software and network security, under the assumption that the underlying hardware is trustworthy. Threats introduced through the global semiconductor supply chain, together with vulnerabilities arising during design and integration, challenge the assumption that hardware can serve as an unquestioned root of trust. Sensor-enabled systems and machine-learning accelerators further expand the hardware attack surface. The undergraduate curriculum of electrical and computer engineering and computer science programs has not evolved accordingly. items.title: Multimode continuous-variable quantum key distribution with CMOS-compatible photonic-electronic integration
items.abstract: Multiplexing and photonic-electronic integration offer a route to scalable and high-throughput quantum key distribution (QKD) networks through parallel transmission and compact hardware suited to volume manufacturing. Realizing this route requires multichannel transmitters and receivers, and a security analysis accounting for mode coupling. Here we present a CMOS-compatible photonic-electronic multimode continuous-variable QKD architecture, using polarization multiplexing as a two-mode example. Silicon-photonic transmitter and receiver chips prepare and detect two polarization modes in parallel. The receiver is co-integrated with a dual-channel 28-nm CMOS transimpedance amplifier, providing shot-noise clearances exceeding 20 dB in both channels. items.title: Optical Thermometry in Monolayer WS2: Raman and Photoluminescence Spectroscopy from 5 K to 1273 K
items.abstract: Reliable temperature measurement is essential for characterizing and engineering two-dimensional (2D) semiconductor devices, yet optical thermometry of 2D materials has so far been demonstrated only over narrow temperature windows spanning a few hundred kelvin. Here, we establish a comprehensive optical thermometry framework for monolayer WS2 from 5~K to 1273~K. We show that: (i) the out-of-plane A1g Raman mode shifts linearly with temperature above 100~K, with a slope of -0.0138 cm^{-1}/K in non-encapsulated WS2 (fitted over 298-1223~K) and a measurably smaller slope of -0.0121 cm^{-1}/K in an hBN-encapsulated sample (fitted over 100-1273~K); (ii) photoluminescence spectra measured over the same 5--1273~K range provide an independent optical indicator of the temperature: the neutral-exciton emission redshifts continuously with temperature and is well described by the semi-empirical Päss...

items.title: A van der Waals Floating-Gate Platform for Broadband Optoelectronic Neuromorphic Computing
items.abstract: Artificial synapses that integrate nonvolatile memory with broadband optoelectronic learning are essential for next-generation neuromorphic computing. However, their realization remains challenging because conventional floating-gate memories exhibit limited optical functionality and poor scalability. Here, we report a van der Waals ReS2/hBN/InSe floating-gate synaptic transistor that combines efficient charge storage with broadband optoelectronic learning in a single device architecture. The heterostructure incorporates InSe as a floating-gate layer for stable charge storage, hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) as a tunneling dielectric, and ReS2 as a photoresponsive channel, enabling carrier tunneling under electrical and optical stimulation. items.title: Photoinduced charging and spatially selective photochemistry on ferroelectric surfaces
items.abstract: Ferroelectric surfaces exhibit polarization-dependent photoreactivity and provide a route to program chemical patterns through local electrical control of polarization. Observations accumulated over several decades show reaction products in domain interiors, at domain boundaries, and in other selected regions, indicating that the mechanisms extend beyond a single polarization-induced band-bending picture. Here we analyze light-induced charging and interfacial reactions on uniformly polarized ferroelectrics and domain patterns, for dry surfaces and surfaces in contact with an electrochemically active solution. items.title: ChroNoC: A Tableless TDM Circuit-Switched NoC With Delay-Aware Deployment for Time-Sensitive Neuromorphic Computing
items.abstract: Time-sensitive neuromorphic architectures require predictable interconnects to preserve precise event timing. Statically scheduled time-division-multiplexed (TDM) circuit-switched networks-on-chip (NoCs) provide deterministic latency at the cost of linear configuration-memory scaling with schedule depth. Furthermore, jointly optimizing task placement, routing, and scheduling creates an intractable combinatorial search space. Existing deployment frameworks also ignore algorithmic axonal delays by forcing immediate spike injections that increase network contention. This paper proposes a hardware-software co-design to address these challenges. items.abstract: Conventional thermal emitters obey Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation, which ties absorptivity to emissivity and places a fundamental limit on a range of radiative energy technologies and sensing systems. This constraint can be overcome using magneto-optic materials, which exhibit nonreciprocal thermal emission under an applied magnetic field. While the spectral nonreciprocity of magneto-optic devices has been explored theoretically and experimentally, nonreciprocal control over the direction of thermal emission has received far less attention. Here, we propose and numerically demonstrate nonreciprocal beam steering of thermal emission, wherein an applied magnetic field lifts the degeneracy between guided modes at +/- kx, enabling asymmetric and tunable directional thermal emission. items.title: Emergent parafermions with tunable localization in a quantum circuit network
items.abstract: \noindent Quantum circuit simulators with hybrid metal-semiconductor dots provide a versatile platform to realize Kondo anyons. These arise at critical points driven by frustrated Kondo screening of dot charge degrees of freedom and have been demonstrated experimentally in linear circuits of one or two dots. Here we study a triangular triple dot device, where geometric frustration gives rise to an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_3$ parafermion shared among the three dots. We show that the parafermion can be tunably relocated to any pair of dots by applying gate voltages, and is supported in both the weak-tunneling `Kondo limit' and the strong transmission `quasiballistic' regime. The critical states survive strong coupling to external leads and other dots, establishing the basis for a scalable and reconfigurable network architecture in which non-Abelian excitations can be realized and manipulated.

items.title: A Rowhammer attack on Fil-C's software capabilities
items.abstract: Rowhammer is a hardware vulnerability in dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) in which repeated accesses to one or more aggressor rows can induce bit-flips in nearby victim rows. This phenomenon violates a core assumption of conventional programming language semantics: that reading from or writing to one memory location does not modify others. Despite the security importance of this phenomenon, there is no widely established formal framework connecting Rowhammer faults with program behaviour. This makes it difficult to reason rigorously about the efficacy of proposed Rowhammer defences and the program-level guarantees they provide. To address this gap, we present a probabilistic small-step operational semantics for an idealised imperative language subject to Rowhammer-style faults. items.abstract: We report on a conceptual framework for optical imaging utilizing exclusively evanescent fields, effectively eliminating or attenuating standard optical diffraction. We present the theoretical foundation of this concept based on the decomposition of dipole radiation into evanescent fields and homogeneous propagating waves, exploring the explicit conditions required to suppress the latter. items.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions govern quasiparticle energies, lifetimes, and temperature-dependent band structures in semiconductors. items.title: Charge state and hydration of vacancies in silicon and silicon carbide in contact with water: A grand-canonical first-principles stability map
items.abstract: The state of a vacancy in a semiconductor is normally described by the Fermi level alone. In wet-etched, electrochemically processed, or humid silicon and silicon carbide, a vacancy also takes up hydrogen and oxygen from water, in amounts set by pH and electrode potential. We treat both effects together by minimizing the grand potential of a vacancy complex over its charge state and hydrogen/oxygen content. The result is a stability map in Fermi level and hydrogen chemical potential, which the computational hydrogen electrode relates to pH and potential. We parameterize it with spin-polarized density functional theory in 64-atom cells, including the vibrational free energy of bound H and O, for the silicon vacancy, its H, O, and OH complexes, and both vacancies of 3C-SiC. items.title: Physics Informed Neural Networks for Solving the Drift-Diffusion Equations
items.abstract: The drift-diffusion equations are the fundamental building block for the modeling, design, and optimization of modern semiconductor devices. Solutions of the drift-diffusion equations rarely give way to analytical forms, and exhibit strong nonlinearity, with the solutions ranging over several orders of magnitude. These attributes have led to research into numerical solvers, and while many commercial Technology Computer Aided Design (TCAD) packages now exist, they may require long simulation times, exhibit sensitivity to initial guesses, and rely on mesh generation. Further, these solvers are not well suited for inverse problems where the design parameters of a device are retrieved from its desired functional characteristics. items.title: Automated Multi-Line Bug Repair Using Model Checker Aided LLMs: A Case Study on RISC-V Processors
items.abstract: Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level(RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resources. Debugging, in particular, remains an especially time-consuming task, requiring careful analysis of simulation traces or counterexamples. Recent work has explored applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to RTL debug and repair with great promise. However, the existing approaches typically are for single-line bugs, operate in open-loop, rely heavily on prompts or retrieval, lack scalability, and often produce incorrect fixes. In this paper, we propose a novel automated RTL bug repair methodology that combines LLMs, assertions, and a model checker to provide scalable, trustworthy semantic grounding and formal guarantees. The oligomers of both materials exhibit relatively disordered structures in the as-cast state, whereas annealing enhances structural order and leads to side-chain-dependent changes in molecular stacking. items.title: Intrinsic Raman Modes and Crystal Symmetry of Altermagnetic $α$-MnTe
items.abstract: Crystal symmetry governs the physical properties of materials and provides the framework for interpreting their microscopic excitations and macroscopic responses. In altermagnets, the crystal symmetries that relate opposite-spin sublattices give rise to momentum-dependent spin splitting despite compensated magnetization. Determining the real crystal symmetry is therefore essential for understanding the intrinsic electronic and magnetic properties. For the altermagnetic semiconductor $α$-MnTe, conflicting Raman assignments have left both its intrinsic lattice excitations and its crystal symmetry unresolved. items.abstract: We develop a unified theory of the interband optical response of a two-dimensional semiconductor with simultaneous Rashba and Dresselhaus spin-orbit couplings in electric and magnetic fields. In crossed fields, the in-plane electric field generates an effective spin-orbit drift field that modifies the Landau spectrum and spinor states, while at zero magnetic field the problem maps onto Landau--Zener spin dynamics.At zero external fields, the total joint density of states above the band gap remains unchanged, while characteristic subgap structures appear. Pure Rashba coupling produces an inverse square root singularity, whereas a finite Dresselhaus term gives a step and a logarithmic peak, allowing the two couplings to be distinguished optically. items.abstract: Disorder can localize valence- and conduction-band states to different degrees, yet whether such localization contrast has observable consequences remains poorly understood. Here, we show that localization contrast strongly impacts competing carrier-recombination channels. We illustrate this behavior in random In$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N alloys. Increasing the In content from $x=13.5\%$ to $x=22\%$ progressively localizes the valence-band maximum state while leaving the conduction-band minimum state comparatively delocalized. This contrasting localization decreases the interband optical momentum matrix element underlying radiative recombination. For Auger-Meitner recombination, however, localization alone does not determine the coupling; atomic-scale disorder also breaks primitive-cell translational symmetry and modifies the momentum-space and phase structure of the states. The first-principle computer simulations are based on the density functional theory employing the pseudopotentials with the exchange-correlation energy given in Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof form. Depending on the direction and the type of the strain, the simulations reveal different types of structural transformations in two-dimensional (2D) h-BN associated with the elastic failure. It is found that, under certain shear strains, there can form an ordered 2D orthorhombic phase with the 2D layer space symmetry pmmm. Thermal stability of the latter up to ~900 K is demonstrated by first-principle Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics. items.title: Electrically Pumped Quadratic-Soliton Mode-Locked Laser in Lithium Niobate Nanophotonics
items.abstract: Femtosecond mode-locked lasers are the workhorse of modern photonics, enabling optical atomic clocks, frequency combs, precision spectroscopy, and ultrafast signal processing. Bringing them onto nanophotonic chips promises miniaturized ultrafast systems, yet combining femtosecond pulse generation with electrical pumping remains a major challenge, rooted in a trade-off between the speed and energy efficiency of mode-locking mechanisms. Kerr-based mechanisms offer nearly instantaneous response but typically require high intracavity peak powers that are difficult to achieve with nanophotonic-compatible semiconductor gain. Conversely, semiconductor saturable absorbers enable strong nonlinear responses at low energies but are limited by their slow carrier dynamics. items.title: Electronic, structural and magnetic properties of goldene nanoribbons
items.abstract: Recently, two-dimensional goldene, a single-atomic-layer gold sheet, has been experimentally realized and is expected to be a promising material for next-generation devices, offering new possibilities beyond three-dimensional bulk gold. Because quasi-one-dimensional derivatives can exhibit properties markedly different from their two-dimensional counterparts, we investigate the stability, electronic, and magnetic properties of goldene-based nanoribbons (GOLDNRs) using first-principles computational methods. Our findings demonstrate that the electronic structure of these nanoribbons depends strongly on both edge chirality and ribbon width. Depending on the boundary configuration, the systems can exhibit semiconducting behavior with electronic band gaps of approximately 0.77 eV and 0.04 eV, or retain metallic characteristics. items.title: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
items.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts. items.title: Observation of Size-dependent Optical Modes and Confinement in Fin Cavities using Angle-Resolved Cathodoluminescence
items.abstract: We observe novel optical fringes and emission coherence in laterally formed semiconductor fins using wavelength- and angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (WARCL). These findings demonstrate that cavity mode and emission confinement are directly governed by cavity geometry including cavity dimensions, facet angles, and orientation. In flat fins narrowing the width from 3000 nm to 200 nm sharpens fringe intensity, indicating stronger mode confinement and increased coherence. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations confirm that the observed fringes originate from internal reflections among the fin facets, consistent with a Fabry-Pérot (FP) cavity model where the cavity length determines the fringe spacing. items.title: Coherent dynamics and ultrafast evolution of optical nonlinearity of self-hybridized exciton-polaritons in WSe2
items.abstract: Exciton-polaritons (EPs) are valuable for investigating macroscopic quantum coherent phenomena. However, overcoming the rapid decoherence of EPs under ambient conditions is challenging, even using delicately fabricated optical cavities. Here, we show pronounced coherent dynamics in thin flakes of WSe2 supporting self-hybridized EPs. Ultrafast two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy (2DES) resolves two types of quantum beating: Rabi oscillation with a period of ~ 24 fs and a slower, ~ 50 fs period oscillation, revealing coherent coupling not only between excitons and cavity, but also between polaritons and dark states. Rapid evolution of 2DES line shape indicates a change of dominant optical nonlinearities from Rabi contraction of polaritons to many-body interactions of excitons in the first 100 fs, marking the transition from coherent to incoherent polariton excitations. items.title: The Spectroscopic Atlas of Excitonic Complexes in hBN-Encapsulated S-TMD Monolayers: From Excitons to Oxcitons and Beyond
items.abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) encapsulation has transformed the optical spectroscopy of semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers (MLs) by suppressing extrinsic disorder and enabling the resolution of an increasingly complex hierarchy of excitonic states. This Review provides a spectroscopy-oriented framework for understanding and identifying excitonic complexes in hBN-encapsulated Mo- and W-based MLs and their alloys. The discussion covers bright and dark excitons, Rydberg states, charged excitons, biexcitons, phonon-assisted replicas, and higher-order Fermi-sea many-body states, including hexcitons and oxcitons, with an emphasis on the experimental signatures that distinguish them. items.title: Online Open-World Wafer Defect Discovery using Hyperdimensional Computing
items.abstract: Conventional wafer defect analysis relies on offline, closed-world classifiers that fail to detect novel, unseen defect signatures emerging during continuous semiconductor manufacturing. To address this, we propose WaferHDC, an online open-world wafer defect discovery framework based on hyperdimensional computing (HDC). The memory-centric architecture of WaferHDC enables rapid anomaly detection and grouping of recurring failures into compact hypervector representations. This allows the memory space to dynamically scale with new defect modes without retraining a static classifier or archiving entire raw wafer history. WaferHDC first models normal spatial distributions, then dynamically groups recurring failures into persistent defect memory without labels or predefined class counts. items.abstract: Ferroelectric layered semiconductors provide a unique platform for exploring coupled excitonic and electronic phenomena in reduced dimensions. Here, exciton transport in layered NbOI$_2$ is investigated using transient absorption microscopy. Ultrafast and strongly anisotropic exciton diffusion is observed. The diffusion coefficient of about 160 cm$^2$ s$^{-1}$ along the nonpolar crystal axis is among the highest reported for van der Waals semiconductors. The transport exhibits an approximately twofold in-plane anisotropy between the polar and nonpolar directions, reflecting the intrinsic low-symmetry crystal structure of NbOI$_2$. The environmental stability of NbOI$_2$ is further investigated, and fabrication and encapsulation conditions required to achieve long-term sample stability are identified. These results establish NbOI$_2$ as a promising platform for studying anisotropic excito...

items.title: Accelerating real-time hybrid-functional calculations with learned ACE and symmetry-based FFT reuse
items.abstract: Real-time hybrid-functional calculations require repeated reconstruction of nonlocal exchange, whose cost grows rapidly with Brillouin-zone sampling. We develop two methods to improve the efficiency of time evolution and spatial processing. The first learns the time evolution of adaptively compressed exchange (ACE) factors and predicts their updates, reducing the frequency of explicit reconstruction. The second uses crystal symmetry to reuse exchange fast Fourier transforms (FFTs) among equivalent real-space points. This symmetry-based FFT reuse (SBFR) reduces the number of FFTs while retaining the full $\bm k$-point sum. The methods can be used with a variety of hybrid functionals, and we use HSE06 in this work. Relative to an ACE reference using full-row mesh FFTs, learned prediction provides more than fivefold acceleration, SBFR more than fourteenfold, and their combination more than...

items.title: Nanophotonic Extreme Ultraviolet Polarimeter
items.abstract: Nanophotonic engineering has revolutionized how we manipulate the polarization of visible light. Here, we extend such control to extreme ultraviolet radiation, the spectral region of attosecond science and semiconductor lithography, where transmissive optical elements are lacking. We implement channel waveguides that restrict incident 41-nm-wavelength light to a few modes with defined spatial profiles and propagation constants. By designing the propagation-length-dependent interference of two eigenmodes, we achieve polarization-dependent forward scattering, which we exploit to create a transmissive nanophotonic analyzer that resolves the polarization axis and spectrum of extreme ultraviolet light from a single measurement. With a 0.9°-sensitivity for polarization rotations in a 1-second measurement and single-shot capability, the device opens new experimental opportunities in ultrafast m...

items.title: Charge-conserving creation and annihilation of topological phase singularities in atomically thin semiconductors
items.abstract: Atomically thin transition metal dichalcogenides provide a promising material platform for optical phase manipulation, as rapid variations in their dielectric functions can give rise to topological phase singularities (PSs). However, PS evolution while preserving topological charge conservation has not yet been investigated in exciton enabled PS systems. Here, using atomically thin MoS2 films on sapphire as a model system, we theoretically and experimentally demonstrate that the evolution of dielectric dispersion determines the creation, trajectory, merging, and annihilation of optical PSs under topological charge conservation. By varying the MoS2 film thickness, we experimentally realize this evolution through the gradual shrinking of the high energy n-k dispersion loop, which modifies its intersection with the zero reflection condition. Our results provide a general strategy for explor...

items.title: Nanocrystalline cubic boron arsenide growth on GaAs(100) by gas source molecular beam epitaxy
items.abstract: Cubic boron arsenide (c-BAs) is a promising ultrahigh thermal conductivity semiconductor, but its direct synthesis on lattice-mismatched substrates remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate the synthesis of nanocrystalline c-BAs thin films on GaAs(100) substrates using gas source molecular beam epitaxy. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an optimal growth temperature window of 250-400 C to maintain near stoichiometry and suppress severe arsenic loss. Surface and structural characterizations via atomic force microscopy, reflection high-energy electron diffraction, and grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction demonstrate a Volmer-Weber 3D island growth mode and a preferential crystallographic alignment with the GaAs substrate. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy confirms a chemically sharp interface without gallium interdiffusion into the c-BAs layer. These findings establish...

items.abstract: Cytokine-mediated inflammation disorders such as sepsis and cytokine release syndrome demand bedside multiplex panels that resolve pro- and anti-inflammatory dynamics in minutes, yet label-free FET cytokine sensors remain limited to few devices, single analytes, and PDMS packaging that sorbs small molecules and leaches oligomers. Two wells carry capture antibodies (anti-IL-6, anti-IL-10), one is a non-specific reference, and one tests specificity; the transduced signal is defined as the differential current relative to the reference signal (Delta I_D(W_n) - Delta I_D(W_3)). items.abstract: We demonstrate a multi-agent framework that takes an analog circuit from topology synthesis to layout. A researcher agent directs schematic and layout agents, a four-tier memory stores the specification and lessons, and separate agents review the designs. Deterministic tools provide pass/fail simulation reports, symbolic analysis, graph-based netlist equivalence, parasitic injection, and extraction with DRC and LVS in every optimization trial. For a fourth-order, 250-Hz subthreshold biopotential low-pass filter, the researcher agent synthesized, through simulation-guided trial and error, a novel current-reuse architecture that shares a single dc bias branch between a super-source-follower biquad and a flipped-voltage-follower biquad. items.abstract: Utility-scale quantum technologies will not only require a well-performing quantum platform, but also classical control hardware that is scalable, efficient, and meets the design requirements set by the quantum system of interest. One approach is the application of silicon CMOS technology, a highly scalable and mature technology, to design application-specific integrated circuits (ASIC) that are optimized for the quantum system. In this work, we present two-qubit control of electron and nuclear spins in NV centres in diamond, using a cryogenic CMOS qubit controller integrated with a diamond quantum device in a cryostat. Using Gate Set Tomography (GST) we characterize the performance of the single-qubit gates on both electron- and carbon nuclear spins, and analyze the limiting noise processes. items.abstract: High-Dynamic-Range (HDR) multi-band linear polarimetry of the solar corona during total solar eclipses provides a vital ground-based diagnostic tool for mapping plasma morphology and magnetic topology in the inner and middle corona. items.title: Privacy-Preserving Robust Monitoring of Dense-Time Temporal Logic
items.abstract: Motivated by the use of third-party testing, this paper presents a privacy-preserving implementation of the robustness monitoring of Signal Temporal Logic (STL). STL is a specification language for systems whose output traces have real-valued timestamps -- most prominently, cyber-physical systems. Its robust semantics, which assign real rather than binary truth values, are an essential ingredient of systems testing and runtime monitoring. In a number of system testing scenarios, the designer and the tester are separate parties. This testing-as-a-service model is common in software, avionics, and semiconductors, and is growing in importance in the red-teaming of machine learning models. In such a model, the designer seeks to preserve the privacy (or secrecy) of its design, while the tester seeks to preserve the privacy of its collateral, including the detailed specification suite. This pa...

items.title: Anchored Exploration in Product Evolution: A Phylogenetic Network Framework for Semiconductor Designs
items.abstract: We develop a product phylogenetic network framework for examining anchored exploration. Using 102,465 semiconductor products grouped into 45,996 design families, we distinguish accumulated design continuity (Anchor) from externally precedented feature additions (horizontal transfer, HT). Fitted regressions yield non-monotonic relationships for HT occurrence and descendant carriage, alongside increasing within-family carriage over observed support. These patterns connect technological trajectories and recombination by distinguishing the continuity associated with incorporating external features from that associated with reproducing them in subsequent products.

items.title: Superradiant temporal transition radiation of a relativistic electron beam
items.abstract: A charge in uniform motion carries a bound field that does not radiate. Transition radiation releases part of it at a boundary in space. We propose and analyze the case of radiation emission due to a boundary in time: a relativistic electron bunch passes through an aperture in a semiconductor (silicon) wafer, and while its bound field occupies the wafer, a femtosecond laser switches the semiconductor into an electron-hole plasma. The field is a valid solution of the old medium and not of the new one, so it is handed to the plasma as an initial condition for radiation emission at the plasma frequency. Because in temporal transition radiation (t-TR) the wavevector is conserved, and the frequency is not, the emission can appear in a spectral band that the bunch's own field does not populate. items.abstract: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. items.title: Coherent Phonon Generation from Prethermal Carrier Populations in a Semiconductor
items.abstract: Ultrafast laser excitation of carriers in semiconductors often results in the creation of fully symmetric coherent optical phonons, typically understood in terms of a thermalized transient carrier population. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. The measured spectral dependence is instead reproduced by a transition-resolved prethermal force weighted by optical matrix elements and band- and momentum-dependent $A_1$ deformation potentials. items.title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
items.abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. Rather than committing to a single representation, TileCas allows an agent to transfer and refine candidates across levels through Cross-Level Diagnosis, which maps correctness and performance feedback to actionable controls at different abstraction level...

items.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. items.abstract: Spin qubits are an attractive platform for scalable quantum computation, and recently, laterally gated quantum dots (QDs) in Ge heterostructures have emerged as a leading implementation. Radio-frequency (RF) single-hole transistor (SHT) spin readout and integrated superconducting resonator charge readout have demonstrated in Ge QDs, but their wiring overhead and on-chip size can pose challenges, while gate dispersive (GD) readout, which requires less on-chip overhead, has yet to be demonstrated for Ge QDs. Here we demonstrate compact, low-overhead RF-GD charge readout of a Ge double QD (DQD), both directly, and assisted by a proximal single-hole box (SHB). items.title: Theoretical study of nitrogen-vacancy spin coherence enhanced by vacancy aggregation in diamond using cluster-correlation expansion
items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV- decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. Cluster-correlation-expansion simulations driven by published electron-paramagnetic-resonance parameters invert that attribution. At a fixed paramagnetic spin density a multi-vacancy bath gives a Hahn-echo coherence time 3.1-7.1 times longer than a bath of isolated negative vacancies, over three decades of concentration. A bath dephases the qubit because its spins exchange spin projections with one another, and two can exchange only if their transition frequencies match. A fine-structure splitting shifts...

items.title: SimSkip: StrongARM-Comparator Similarity Sensing with SAR-Skipping-Aware Training for Analog Compute-in-Memory
items.abstract: Analog-to-digital conversion dominates the energy and area of analog compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerators. This paper presents SimSkip, a successive-approximation-register (SAR) skipping scheme that combines a lightweight StrongARM-comparator similarity detector with SAR-skipping-aware training. When two held voltages are similar, the upper bits of the preceding code are reused to skip SAR comparisons. Detector-induced disturbance extracted from 55-nm CMOS simulations and bit-exact prefix saturation are embedded in the forward pass, and the network learns to tolerate them through quantization-aware training and knowledge distillation. On an ISAAC-based W4A4 WRN-28-10, SimSkip achieves 77.23% CIFAR-100 top-1 accuracy (mean of three seeds) versus 78.4% for the baseline, while reducing SAR comparisons by 48.2% across three hardware-modeled layers. A first-order model estimates a 27.2% net A...

items.title: A semiconductor photon-pair source based on a polariton cascade
items.abstract: We present a theoretical study of a semiconductor photon-pair source based on a radiative cascade enabled by a permanent exciton dipole. The source consists of a GaAs quantum dot placed between a metal nanoparticle and a mirror. The dot exciton and the localized electromagnetic mode mix to form upper and lower polaritons. Without a permanent dipole, a symmetry separating states with even and odd excitation numbers forbids photon emission between the polaritons. Separation of the mean electron and hole positions gives the exciton a permanent dipole and breaks this symmetry. The upper polariton can then emit an idler photon as it decays to the lower polariton. The lower polariton can emit a signal photon as the system returns to its ground state. Using an effective model, we calculate the probability that a prepared upper polariton emits both photons through the metal antenna. We also anal...

items.title: Accelerating Periodic Coupled Cluster and Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Theories With Frozen Natural Orbitals
items.abstract: We present a unified frozen natural orbital (FNO) framework for periodic Gaussian-orbital post-Hartree-Fock calculations with explicit k-point sampling. The approach includes conventional ground-state FNOs together with state-specific (SS-FNO) and state-averaged (SA-FNO) variants constructed from perturbative one-particle density matrices. We implement these approximations for periodic Moller-Plesset perturbation theory, algebraic diagrammatic construction, and equation-of-motion coupled cluster methods in the PySCF software package and benchmark them for correlation energies, equations of state, fundamental band gaps, and quasiparticle band structures of semiconductors and insulators. FNO truncation reproduces canonical results with small errors while substantially reducing computational cost. SS-FNO enables accurate large-basis band-gap calculations, including quadruple-zeta results, w...

items.title: JANUS: A Multi-modal Foundation Neural Sampler for Disordered Materials
items.abstract: Disordered materials are central to modern technologies, from high-performance alloys to quantum devices, yet understanding and designing them requires exploring an enormous space of compositions and atomic arrangements. Here we introduce JANUS, a multimodal neural sampler that jointly explores chemical composition, atomic structure and volume, learning directly from the energy of the system without requiring pre-generated equilibrium configurations. Across test systems, JANUS reproduces reference equilibrium properties and recovers free energy and phase behavior with about three orders of magnitude fewer energy evaluations than reference Monte Carlo sampling. In multicomponent alloys, JANUS reproduces experimentally observed local chemical order and can be steered to further enhance chemical order and stiffness. Coupled to an evolutionary language model agent, it also enables efficient...

items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q and Small-Mode-Volume Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.title: Real-Time FPGA-Based Multi-Parameter Feedback Stabilization of a Silicon Double Quantum Dot
items.abstract: Long term operation of semiconductor spin qubits requires active stabilization of quantum dot potentials against low-frequency charge noise. To address this, we demonstrate a gradient-descent feedback approach in a silicon double quantum dot device using high-bandwidth radio-frequency (rf) reflectometry readout and a field-programmable gate array (FPGA) for digital signal processing. This architecture enables continuous multi-parameter gradient calculation and quick gate voltage updates, significantly increasing the effective feedback bandwidth compared to previous methods relying on slow direct-current transport measurements. By operating with 8 steps per feedback cycle and an integration time of 25.6 $μ$s, this high-speed stabilization scheme maintains better than -6 dB of noise suppression up to 5 kHz, achieving an attenuation of $-7.4 \pm 0.2$ dB at the maximum measured frequency. Th...

items.title: Odd-even dichotomy in the waveforms of modified Emden oscillators of arbitrary integer power
items.abstract: Closed-form waveforms of the modified Emden oscillators $\ddot x+(q+2)kx^q\dot x+k^2x^{2q+1}+ω^2x=0$ of arbitrary natural power $q$, and of their damped $c$-deformed versions, are obtained through a generalized commutative factorization that reduces them to Bernoulli equations. We show that commutative factorizations of Liénard equations are gauge-conjugated forms of the nonlocal linearizing transformation of Chandrasekar, Senthilvelan, Kundu and Lakshmanan, the factorization constant being half the difference of the roots of the associated linear oscillator. These oscillators display an odd--even dichotomy: for odd $q$ they are isochronous, with period $2π/ω$ independent of the amplitude, within an explicitly bounded range of the integration constant, while for even $q$ the oscillations decay algebraically, as $t^{-1/q}$. The dichotomy is confirmed by an elliptic polar representation, i...

items.title: Strain engineering of transient exciton diffusion in WSe2 monolayers at cryogenic temperatures
items.abstract: Tungsten-based transition metal dichalcogenides exhibit dark excitons as the energetically lowest states. These are crucial for exciton thermalization and propagation and they dominate low-temperature photoluminescence via the emergence of pronounced phonon sidebands. After a resonant excitation, highly mobile hot dark excitons are formed, which quickly thermalize into an equilibrium distribution. The application of strain modifies the exciton energy landscape and, in particular, the relative energy separation between bright and dark exciton states. The impact of strain on the transient photoluminescence and diffusion of non-equilibrium excitons has remained largely unexplored so far. In this work, we investigate the spatiotemporal exciton dynamics in strained hBN-encapsulated WSe2 monolayers at cryogenic temperatures. We demonstrate that tensile strain abruptly increases the excess ener...

items.title: THz-Driven Floquet Spin Valve-Modulator
items.abstract: Within the scattering matrix ($S$-matrix) framework adapted to the high-frequency Floquet--Magnus formalism based on the length gauge, we investigate spin-dependent quantum transport in a 1D quantum ring with an asymmetric ($π/2$) configuration of quantum point contacts. We demonstrate the realization of a contactless electromagnetic analog of the Datta--Das spin field-effect transistor with ferromagnetic leads operating at zero static magnetic field. It is shown that an off-resonance terahertz (THz) field enables high-precision switching between spin channels without altering the static parameters of the nanostructure. Driven by an electronic Vernier effect, the quantum interference in the asymmetric geometry yields a selective spin phase rotator alongside an ultra-high-contrast current-suppression regime (``optical shutter''). The proposed architecture is fundamentally robust against m...

items.title: Decoherence of a quantum magneto-oscillator: Effect of field-bath interaction
items.abstract: We investigate the quantum dissipative dynamics of a charged magneto-oscillator(CMO) coupled to a heat bath of harmonic oscillators in the presence of an additional field-bath interaction. The problem is formulated within the framework of the generalized quantum Langevin equation, where the external confining potential modifies the random force correlations and the memory kernel of the environment, and the effective spring constant. Using the corresponding non-Markovian master equation, we examine the influence of the field-bath coupling on the temporal decay of the reduced density matrix of the system. We show that the additional interaction leads to an enhancement of the decoherence rate by altering the dissipative response of the bath. Thus our results shed light on the role of field-bath coupling in the quantum to classical transition of a CMO. The resulting fluctuation-dissipation r...

items.title: Parity-selected charging and noise-correlated work retention in a coupled Si/SiGe double quantum dot battery: theory and experimentally parameterized modeling
items.abstract: We investigate extractable work storage in a capacitively coupled double quantum dot (DQD) quantum battery (QB) subjected to experimentally motivated detuning charge noise. The battery is modeled as two interacting charge qubits with an Ising-type capacitive coupling and is charged by resonant microwave modulation of the tunnel coupling channel. Detuning fluctuations are introduced as classical stochastic processes generated from a band-limited 1/f noise spectrum. For each noise realization, the evolution remains unitary, whereas decoherence and loss of contrast emerge after ensemble averaging. We analyze the total ergotropy, its population and coherent contributions, the energy basis populations, a passive ordering violation diagnostic, and the Jensen-Shannon coherence of the noise-averaged state. The results show that resonant tunnel coupling driving selects a dominant E0 E3 population...

items.title: High-Fidelity Synthetic Transmission Electron Microscopy Image Generation Using Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Data-Limited Semiconductor Metrology
items.abstract: Advanced semiconductor nodes drastically increased demand for Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), yet destructive sample preparation, slow imaging and high costs severely limit the availability of diverse datasets needed for downstream machine learning (ML). Synthetic data generation is becoming essential, but current generative models often miss TEM-specific noise, structural detail, and stochastic variability crucial for evaluation. We present a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) framework for synthetic TEM image generation under extreme data scarcity. A progressive patch-based training strategy scales from low-resolution patches to full images, enabling from-scratch training with only 15 samples. We integrate a custom TrivialAugment adaptation, cross-process domain transfer, classifier guidance, and RePaint-style inpainting, culminating in full-image generation that pr...

items.title: Dispersive mode coupling in $p$-doped semiconductor nanomechanical resonators
items.abstract: Dispersive coupling between vibrational modes with different frequencies is a major nonlinear dynamical effect. We show that in $p$-doped semiconductors such coupling is strongly enhanced. Moreover, the coupling parameters increase with the order of the nonlinearity. The doping-induced dispersive coupling becomes much stronger than the intrinsic one already for moderately strong doping. Its dependence on the hole density is nonmonotonic, and the temperature dependence becomes nonmonotonic for higher densities. Relevant mesoscopic frequency fluctuations are briefly discussed. The results are applied to Si resonators, where doping is used to compensate the temperature dependence of a clock mode, whereas another low-frequency mode is used as a thermometer to enable temperature stabilization.

items.title: Quantum digital simulations of time-domain semiconductor spectroscopy in the semi-classical approximation
items.abstract: We present a digital quantum simulation framework for ultrafast optical spectroscopy of semiconductor materials. The framework is based on Brillouin-zone discretization and is designed as a quantum alternative to classical simulations based on the semiconductor Bloch equations. Its current capabilities include quantum simulations of linear absorption and optical gain, incorporating Lorentzian broadening, finite-temperature band-filling effects, and reduced-dimensionality effects. Comparison with classical simulations of GaAs within the single-particle approximation demonstrates quantitative agreement in the noiseless limit. The inclusion of realistic hardware noise characteristic of NISQ-era quantum computers effectively manifests as an additional source of scattering, resulting in increased spectral broadening. We also show that the linear optical response, including many-body interacti...

items.title: Electrically tunable Crossed Andreev Reflection in Bipolar Magnetic Semiconductors
items.abstract: Crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) is a nonlocal quantum transport phenomenon that arises at the interfaces between a superconductor and two spatially separated metals. In this process, an electron incident from one metal combines with another electron originating from the other metal to form a Cooper pair in the SC. In this work, we theoretically investigate the quantum transport properties of a device comprising a central $s$-wave superconductor sandwiched between two bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS) leads. BMS materials possess a unique bandstructure where the conduction and valence bands are fully spin-polarized in opposite directions. By applying independent gate voltages to the two BMS leads, we selectively tune their chemical potentials to configure an antiparallel spin alignment at the Fermi energy.
